input_sequence.comment: The ordinary ready gate, typed stage publication, load, allocation and spawn are live.
Usable control, with one bounded Skip if the authored intro owns input.
The agent (host player 0) dies through playerDie: the counter-operative's win.

The agent's own results, a failed mission, after the death animation. Same at_ms as the kill: the harness sorts events by at_ms (stable, JSON order for ties), so an earlier at_ms here would wait before the kill.
Scripted clean exit 12 s (script time, paused during waits) after the results, once the client has left its own.
